source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Learning From Data' under topic 6.3 (PDF 78, printed 74).

blocks.text: Data se seekhne ka matlab hai purani maloomat se faisle behtar karna. Is amal mein data ek learning model ko input ke taur par diya jata hai, aur model data ke andar ke rishte (relationships) parakhta hai. Baar baar training se ghaltiyan kam hoti hain aur nataij zyada durust hote jate hain. Yeh seekhna kabhi khatam nahi hota, kyunke naya data milne par model update hota hai. Is tarah system waqt ke saath zyada smart hota jata hai.
